intent: Explain the dangerous settings action with one focal mark, preserving the existing warning and confirmation. App.vue remove() changes saved to false only after confirm('Delete saved settings?'); it does not implement persistent storage deletion. The native warning describes device-local scope and retained account/documents. Avoid duplicating that visible warning with an overlay note or an arrow to the conditional consequences paragraph. Use a Vue post-render effect and core handle cleanup to toggle the annotation independently of its native host; destination changes do not affect this persistent target.

targets.description: The single existing button#delete, type=button, with @click=remove and aria-describedby=native-warning. The ref is attached directly to this persistent native button, outside the destination conditional.

options.description: You will be asked to confirm before deleting saved settings.
